localizedValues.name: American Kitchen
localizedValues.description:
This day use heritage place provides an excellent facility for meetings, weddings and special events in a lush setting. Rental includes the 1500 square foot kitchen (complete with cook top stove, oven, microwave, refrigerator and freezer), 3X3 foot charcoal grill, gazebo, and a covered 12X20 foot stage. Interior Indoor capacity of 85 people; combined with grounds rental, capacity of 125. There are indoor tables and chairs that come with the rental. There is a limited supply of outdoor chairs and tables available to rent for an additional charge.
Guests are responsible for cleaning up. Failure to clean will result in additional fees.
PLEASE NOTE: If your group is over 20 people and/or special set up is required (i.e. canopies, amplified music, professional filming/photography, commercial/business use, serving alcohol, and having vendors like food trucks/caterers), you MUST contact the Park at rickey.blank@parks.wa.gov or peace.arch@parks.wa.gov or call (360) 332-8221 regarding a special activity permit at least 60 days in advance of your event. Failure to do so or groups exceeding maximum occupancy can result in the cancellation of your event.
Since the park is bordering two countries, please be aware that US Dept of Homeland Security, Customs & Border Protection and Royal Canadian Mounted Police can ask to see hard copies of legal documentation to reside in the country you are visiting from.
